_comment: Every number carries its evidence grade. This sandbox cannot fetch *.atlassian.com, so Atlassian limits are ASSUMED (search-reported): a web-search summary of the cited page, fetched 2026-10-01. Entries graded VERIFIED were read directly from an npm package tarball. Re-grade only after reading the cited URL yourself. See docs/spikes/02-forge-only-compute-feasibility.md, 'Confirm locally'.

manifest_schema.function_memoryMB_description: You can configure memory between 128 MB and 1024 MB in 1-MB increments. The default value is 512 MB.
manifest_schema.app_runtime_memoryMB_description: between 128 MB and 1024 MB ... default 512 MB
manifest_schema.cpu_scales_with_memory: Increasing the function memory also increases its CPU allocation.
manifest_schema.note: The schema's memoryMB maximum (4096) disagrees with its own description (1024). The model uses 1024, the documented figure.
manifest_schema.containers: services[].containers[] with key, tag, health (http route), resources.cpu (e.g. '500m' or '1'), resources.memory (e.g. '512Mi', '2Gi'); services[].scaling {min >= 0, max >= 1}; consumers and scheduled triggers may target an 'endpoint' instead of a function.

async_events.note: Scope of the 500-per-minute figure (per installation or per app) is not stated in the summary.

forge_prices.note: Whether free allowances are per app or per installation is not stated in the summary.

containers.status: Preview (some doc pages still titled EAP)
containers.pricing_model: reservation-based: billed for reserved CPU and memory whether or not requests are handled
containers.scaling_note: The EAP-era page says one instance, no scaling; the Preview announcement says the scaling profile can be customised per environment and region, and the manifest schema has scaling min/max. The sources disagree.
containers.runs_on_atlassian_note: Atlassian describes container services as eligible for Runs on Atlassian (search-reported; not confirmed against the program page).

confluence_rest_quota.tier2_note: Per-tenant pools are assigned only after review for apps with exceptionally high or concentrated usage; increases cannot be requested on demand.

forge_remote_tokens.note: A 'Forge Remote access to tokens anytime' Preview exists and may relax this.

criteria: Apps exclusively use Atlassian-hosted compute and storage
Apps support data residency matching the host Atlassian app
Customers can control external data egress (for example analytics and logs) via admin controls
manifest_must_not_list: external fetch domains (except analytics without in-scope end-user data)
